# Referensi command doforme

<!-- Generated by scripts/update_docs.py; do not edit. -->

Versi plugin: **0.20.1**.

| Command | Kegunaan | Agent | Input |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| /doforme:analyze | Investigate a bug with evidence and return a read-only analysis report | doforme:investigator | &lt;bug description or local issue file; requirement exports/excerpts with provenance&gt; |
| /doforme:doctor | Check fresh-workflow prerequisites without executing source, tests or models | doforme:preflight-reader | &lt;explicit issue input file; optional repo profile and fresh external output path&gt; |
| /doforme:endtoend | Run the local gated workflow to PR draft preparation without publication | doforme:workflow-runner | &lt;issue/config JSON, optional repo profile, external output; explicit authorization&gt; |
| /doforme:fix | Apply a reviewed repair plan within explicitly authorized local scope | doforme:fixer | &lt;plan v2 file; authorize exact edit paths and validation commands&gt; |
| /doforme:init | Inspect repository readiness or explicitly create draft onboarding files | doforme:repo-onboarder | [--write to create .doforme/repository.json and .doforme/requirements.md] |
| /doforme:plan | Build a read-only repair plan from a verified doforme analysis report | doforme:planner | &lt;local analyze v2 report or complete inline report with requirement sources&gt; |
| /doforme:pr | Prepare a reviewable PR draft without publishing or pushing | doforme:pr-preparer | &lt;plan, fix, test and passing review reports; issue/repo references&gt; |
| /doforme:review | Independently review a tested repair and its requirement evidence | doforme:reviewer | &lt;plan v2, fix v1, test v1 with content binding&gt; |
| /doforme:status | Inspect an explicitly named local checkpoint without running workflow stages | doforme:status-reader | &lt;external checkpoint directory for the current target&gt; |
| /doforme:test | Independently execute authorized validation against a scoped fix | doforme:tester | &lt;plan v2 and fix v1 reports; authorize exact test commands/artifacts&gt; |

Referensi ini dibuat dari manifest dan frontmatter command. Ini bukan bukti
bahwa fitur telah diuji melalui model atau memenuhi requirement bisnis.

Panduan: [instalasi](INSTALLATION.md), [penggunaan](USAGE.md),
